common_premises.assurance: STATIC_FROZEN_SOURCE_COVERAGE_ONLY; every proposed leaf/selector NOT_REGISTERED/NOT_RUN; proof obligations closed0; independent B1/B2 credit NONE
common_premises.notation: All intervals [start,end) are element offsets, relative to active v or scratch unless backing offset is explicitly stated. n=input length, h=floor(n/2), r=n-h. p=relative tail offset; insert span length=p+1. No pointer provenance is inferred from numeric interval checks.
common_premises.finite_values: Arbitrary independent bytes0..255; count complete logical values, including duplicates. No reduced alphabet, binary-network enumeration, tag-only or N32-only promotion.
common_premises.finite_comparator: Exact T=u8 / F=sorting_model::KeyLess<u8>, pure full-byte <, same effective cfg and actual body. Cell/NonCopyByte use their own KeyLess<T>, never the u8 provider.
common_premises.generic_boundary: Production F:FnMut(&T,&T)->bool is wider. Sorting needs a suitable strict weak order and nonmutating observation; frame summaries additionally need no writes outside admitted element footprint. Arbitrary callbacks, mutation, panic/unwind, stability, termination and generic T/F remain separate obligations.
common_premises.bindings: Actual callee/source/tool/cfg/contract stack/provider/root identities and fresh exact check/role/cover inventories must agree; a registration/assumed consumer/model witness/runtime SUCCESS is not admission. Preserve every original default/unsupported/unreachable check and original S2 strict verdict.
common_premises.memory: Aligned initialized readable typed input; exclusive writable destinations may start MaybeUninit, so prove initialized coverage before every typed/spec read. Valid same-allocation offsets, multiplication/address nonwrap and nonoverlap are obligations in addition to interval bounds. Zero-size types require separate reasoning.
common_premises.post_frame: Sorted normal output, equal length and full-value multiplicities; source preservation for copy-based helpers, exact pair/active-span write footprints, outside/canary frames and initialized final output. Finite canary observations alone do not establish arbitrary exterior memory locality.
common_premises.composition: Each call requires caller-to-provider implication for T/F/cfg/length/backing/base/offset/init/frame; prove loop invariants, not assume them. Exact leaf return must initialize the region consumed by the next call. Leaf admission never automatically admits its consumer.
common_premises.failure_paths: Keep abort/ord-violation/unwind paths and guard validity; prove order-violation unreachable only for the chosen lawful comparator. Do not stub panic to claim success. Normal partial correctness does not prove termination/unwind.
common_premises.scratch_locality: A fixed backing48 or view n+16 within backing48 is not an exact n+16 allocation, nor arbitrary capacity>=n+16. Similarly backing34 canaries at slice edges do not prove every larger/interior allocation. Region-locality or explicit finite geometry coverage remains required.

Scratch[0,h) and [h,n) become sorted before merge; scratch[n,n+16) is sort8 work area when selected. Preserve unmodified scratch outside all written intervals and source v until final merge.
geometry.N: Initialized active v[0,n); private production stack MaybeUninit<[T;32]>. Network/insert modify disjoint regions in v, preserving all other positions; for n>=18 sorted halves merge from v[0,n) into separate stack[0,n), then initialize/copy back n elements; stack[n,32) is outside footprint.
geometry.sort8_calls: For n16..32 size<=16: (v+0,scratch+0,scratch+n), (v+h,scratch+h,scratch+n+8), each src/dst/temp length8. Internal sort4 inputs offset0/4 in each src; outputs offset0/4 in each temp. Internal merge source=temp[0,8), dst=dst[0,8), same scratch allocation. General final merge source=scratch[0,n), dst=v[0,n), opposite allocation direction.
